item.title: 1.0.0-beta.7
item.description:
## What’s New in anotherNotch 1.0.0-beta.6
### 🚀 Release Channels - **Stable & Beta Updates**: Choose your update track directly in **Settings → About**. - **Instant Channel Switching**: Opt in to beta releases or stay on stable builds anytime.
### 📐 Notch Geometry & Layout - **Physical Notch Alignment**: Closed state stays flush with hardware notch height during expand/collapse transitions. - **Adaptive Spacing**: Dynamic left, right, and bottom insets automatically match Center Black coverage.
### 📋 Clipboard Experience - **Searchable History**: Keyboard focus and typing in the search bar. - **Polished Visuals**: Rounded, layered search styling matching macOS design language.
### ⚡ Performance & Polish - Background module services only initialize when installed. - Smoother shell resize and close animations.
--- **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jinkun1998/another.notch/compare/v1.0.0-beta.5...v1.0.0-beta.6

item.title: 1.0.0-beta.6
item.description:
## What’s New
### Modular Notch
- Install, remove, and reorder bundled Clipboard, Shelf, Calendar, and Camera tabs. - Module services start only when installed, reducing unused background activity.
### Refined Layout
- Unified expanded-notch spacing across every tab. - Adaptive side and bottom clearance responds to transparency coverage. - Improved physical-notch alignment, shell sizing, transitions, and multi-display positioning.
### Clipboard Polish
- Clipboard search now accepts keyboard input. - Refined search field with rounded visual treatment.
### Improvements
- Refined onboarding and Settings navigation for installed modules. - Improved tab visibility, header actions, and module-specific behavior.
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/jinkun1998/another.notch/compare/v1.0.0-beta.4...v1.0.0-beta.5
